notes.subject: feat(retrieval): upgrade LanceDB and drop Intel Mac support
notes.summary: Upgrades LanceDB and drops Intel Mac (darwin-x64) support; installers and the VS Code install commands now require Apple Silicon.

notes.subject: chore(vscode): require VS Code 1.140 and align API types
notes.summary: The VS Code extension now requires VS Code 1.140.0 or newer, so older editors can no longer install the current release.

notes.subject: fix(terminal): report shell output when native shell startup times out
notes.summary: Native shell startup timeouts now report the shell's last output, such as an update prompt, in the error and output channel log.

notes.subject: feat(cli): migrate multiline input to Ink 8
notes.summary: The CLI multiline composer moves to Ink 8 with a local editor supporting cursor movement, paste, and horizontal scrolling of long lines.

notes.subject: fix(terminal): keep tasks menu within the webview viewport
notes.summary: The terminal tasks menu now stays inside the webview viewport instead of overflowing the left edge in narrow panels.

notes.subject: fix(agent): restore pending ask_user cards for non-foreground chat tabs
notes.summary: Pending ask_user questions in non-foreground chat tabs are now persisted and restored on reload instead of being treated as interrupted.

notes.subject: fix: address triaged tool feedback
notes.summary: Fixes search_files match limits and offsets, ignores no-op document version bumps in edit review, logs sandbox probe errors, and warns when attaching to an outdated browser gateway helper.

notes.subject: fix(openai-compatible): count inline images at a fixed cost in usage fallback
notes.summary: Inline images are now counted at a fixed token cost in the OpenAI-compatible usage fallback, preventing repeated automatic condensing after a screenshot.

notes.subject: fix: address triaged tool feedback
notes.summary: Budget-exhausted background results include a completed-tool digest, sandboxed gh keyring failures get host-credential guidance, more config secrets are redacted, and compose telemetry records rejected children.

notes.subject: fix(tools): refuse write_file rewrites that replace secrets with the redaction placeholder
notes.summary: write_file now refuses full rewrites of structured config files that would replace existing secret values with the [REDACTED] placeholder.

notes.subject: feat(terminal): choose workspace directories inside the terminal panel
notes.summary: In multi-project workspaces, the AgentLink Terminal panel now shows its own in-panel directory chooser (keyboard navigable, cancellable) instead of VS Code's top-of-window quick pick.

notes.subject: feat(meridian): add AgentLink companion plugin and integration skill
notes.summary: Adds a standalone Meridian companion plugin and install script that keeps AgentLink's tools eagerly loaded for single-turn handoff, plus a maintenance skill and integration probe.

notes.subject: feat(updates): add user-triggered self-update for CLI, Desktop, and VS Code
notes.summary: Adds user-triggered self-update: VS Code gets Install Update and Reload for Update commands, Desktop gets install/restart actions, and the CLI gets `agentlink updates --install` and an /updates install option, all with checksum-verified downloads.

notes.subject: feat(prompts): add per-model prompt profile selection across surfaces
notes.summary: Adds per-model prompt profile selection: compatible models accept promptProfile (compatibility or reasoning), applied across VS Code, Browser Ask Agent, Desktop and the CLI, with new Codex defaults and a new SDK prompt-profile entry point.

notes.subject: fix(feedback): preserve complete reports and retrieve them by id
notes.summary: send_feedback now preserves complete reports up to 128 KiB, and get_feedback gains id lookup with paging to retrieve the full record, while lists and the sidebar label shortened previews.

notes.subject: fix: recover expired MCP sessions, index tiny files, exact-save bulk replace
notes.summary: Adds save_without_formatting to find_and_replace, recovers expired Streamable HTTP MCP sessions, indexes tiny files, and lets embedded hosts set maxAttachments to 0.

notes.subject: chore(deps): update AI SDKs and in-range dependencies
notes.summary: Updates AI SDKs (openai, MCP SDK, ACP SDK, zod) and other in-range dependencies, and makes sandbox runtime packaging tolerate hoisted dependencies.

notes.subject: chore(deps): bump pinned runtime dependencies
notes.summary: Bumps pinned runtime dependencies including sandbox-runtime, keyring, ajv, electron, ws and yaml.

notes.subject: chore(deps): bump Node library majors
notes.summary: Bumps Node library majors (eventsource, simple-git, https-proxy-agent, commander, marked, osx-sign) and fixes shadow-repo checkpoint creation that was silently failing.

notes.subject: chore(deps): bump UI library majors and keep the CLI on Ink 7
notes.summary: Upgrades UI libraries (preact 11, monaco 0.57, xterm 6, mermaid 12), themes the xterm scrollbar, and keeps the CLI on Ink 7.

notes.subject: chore(deps): bump web-tree-sitter and stabilise tests under Preact 11
notes.summary: Bumps web-tree-sitter to 0.27 and adds test setup to stabilise tests under Preact 11.

notes.subject: chore(deps): bump vitest 5 and jsdom 30
notes.summary: Upgrades vitest and jsdom dev tooling and renames the vitest config to .mts.

notes.subject: chore(deps): bump oxfmt to 0.72 and apply its formatting
notes.summary: Bumps the oxfmt formatter and applies formatting-only changes.

notes.subject: fix(terminal): match sandbox runtime proxy wrapper contract
notes.summary: Fixes the sandbox runtime helper's proxy wrapper checks to match sandbox-runtime 0.0.79, preventing repeated helper_protocol_failed errors.

notes.subject: chore(deps): update vega-lite and web-tree-sitter
notes.summary: Updates vega-lite to 6.5.0 and web-tree-sitter to 0.27.1.

notes.subject: fix: align CLI keyring checks and isolate checkpoint test setup
notes.summary: Aligns CLI bundle manifest and verification checks with the updated @napi-rs/keyring 2.1.0 version.

notes.subject: fix(core): build CommonJS prompt profile export
notes.summary: Adds the promptProfilePolicy module to the core package's CommonJS build so its export is available to CommonJS consumers.
